name: avatar_parameter_control
description: Control VRChat avatar parameters with smooth interpolation

avatar_id.description: ID of the avatar to control

parameter_name.description: Name of the parameter to set (e.g., VRCEmote, VRCFaceBlendH)

value.description: Value to set for the parameter (0.0 to 1.0 for most parameters)

interpolate.description: Whether to smoothly interpolate to the new value

template: Control avatar {avatar_id} by setting {parameter_name} to {value}. Use {interpolate} interpolation over {duration} seconds with {easing} easing.

examples.output: Set the VRCEmote parameter on avatar my_avatar to 1 with smooth interpolation over 2.0 seconds using ease_out easing.
Set the VRCFaceBlendH parameter on avatar player_avatar to 0.8 with smooth interpolation over 0.5 seconds using ease_out easing.
